groups.title: Groups
groups.subtitle: Two halves of the workspace. Every track belongs to one group, so any list in the app can be narrowed to just your side of the work.
groups.settingsHint: Rename the two halves of the workspace and choose which group each track belongs to.
groups.loadFailed: The groups could not be loaded.
groups.emptyHint: Groups are created with the workspace. If this list is empty the migration that adds them has not run.
groups.nameArHint: Shown while the app is in Arabic. Leave it empty to fall back to the English name.
groups.nameRequired: Give the group an English name of 40 characters or fewer.
groups.errNameTaken: Another group already uses that English name.
groups.errNameArTaken: Another group already uses that Arabic name.
groups.errNameLength: A group name has to be between 1 and 40 characters.
groups.movedOut: ⁨{name}⁩ is no longer in a group
groups.ungroupedHint: A group filter will never find these tracks, and they are left out of every group total. Choose a group for each one.
groups.emptyGroup: No tracks yet. Use the Group menu on any track to move it here.
